title: PaymentTransaction
description: Payment for a completed ride. Deliberately arrives 5 to 90 seconds after ride completion, which is why every join against it must tolerate lateness. This topic intentionally uses JSON Schema rather than Avro so the platform demonstrates both registry-backed formats.

ride_id.description: Ride being paid for; join key against rides.sessions.

amount_cents.description: Amount in cents; matches fare_cents on the completed ride for successful card and wallet payments.

ts.description: Transaction time as UTC epoch milliseconds.
